title: Pope Leo XIV meets abuse victims in Peru, says Church must make 'amends'
summary: Pope Leo XIV met six victims of clerical abuse in Peru on Thursday, including people linked to disbanded group Sodalitium Christianae Vitae. The US-born pontiff also urged the Catholic Church to make amends to survivors and strengthen protections against abuse as he returned to the country where he served as a missionary and bishop for nearly two decades.
